Package ui

Class MenuPane

java.lang.Object
ui.MenuPane
public class MenuPane extends Object
Manager menu editor. Selecting a row fills the form; clearing it starts a new item. Seasonal items are limited-time drinks: they get their own tab at the register, and Remove from Menu takes one off the menu when its season is over.

    • saveItem

      private void saveItem()
      Checks the editor and adds a new item or saves the selected one, then reloads and re-selects it. Problems are shown next to the buttons; database errors show a dialog.

    • removeItem

      private void removeItem()
      Takes the selected item off the menu after the manager confirms.

    • reload

      Reloads the items and categories from the store and clears the selection.

    • validate

      private static void validate(String name, String category, BigDecimal price)
      Checks an item before saving.
      Parameters:
      name - the item's name
      category - its category
      price - its price in dollars
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the name or category is empty or too long, or the price is negative, has more than two decimal places, or is too large
